title: The week in pictures: US strikes on Nigerian jihadists, AFCON 2025 and the death of Brigitte Bardot
summary: Morocco hosted the ongoing Africa Cup of Nations, Russia attacked the Ukrainian capital with more than 650 drones just two days before Christmas, the US carried out strikes against militants linked to the Islamic State group (IS) in Nigeria, and the cinema world paused to remember Brigitte Bardot: FRANCE 24 looks back at the week's most striking images.
